# ciphertrust_azure_vault (Resource)

Use this resource to create and manage Azure Key Vaults in CipherTrust Manager CCKM.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `azure` (String) (Immutable) JSON array string of vault descriptors from the discovery step.
- `connection_id` (String) (Immutable) ID of the Azure connection in CipherTrust Manager.
- `subscription_id` (String) (Immutable) Azure subscription ID.

### Optional

- `acls` (Attributes Set) Access control list entries for the vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))
- `enable_rotation` (Boolean) Set to true to enable key rotation; false to disable.
- `managed_hsm` (Boolean) (Immutable) Set to true to register an Azure Managed HSM vault.
- `name` (String) Name of the vault in CipherTrust CCKM.
- `rotation_job_params` (String) JSON string of rotation job parameters. Required when enable_rotation is true.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) CipherTrust account URI.
- `application` (String) CipherTrust application URI.
- `azure_name` (String) Azure name of the vault.
- `azure_vault_id` (String) Azure resource ID of the vault.
- `cloud_key_backup_limit` (Number) Cloud key backup limit.
- `cloud_name` (String) Cloud name (e.g. AzureCloud).
- `connection_name` (String) Name or UUID of the Azure connection as returned by CM.
- `create_mode` (String) Vault create mode from Azure properties.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the vault was registered in CM.
- `dev_account` (String) CipherTrust dev account URI.
- `enable_purge_protection` (Boolean) Whether purge protection is enabled.
- `enable_rbac_authorization` (Boolean) Whether RBAC authorization is enabled.
- `enable_soft_delete` (Boolean) Whether soft delete is enabled.
- `enabled_for_deployment` (Boolean) Whether vault is enabled for deployment.
- `enabled_for_disk_encryption` (Boolean) Whether vault is enabled for disk encryption.
- `enabled_for_template_deployment` (Boolean) Whether vault is enabled for template deployment.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID (UUID) for this vault.
- `labels` (Map of String) CipherTrust labels.
- `location` (String) Azure region where the vault is located.
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU details of the vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `soft_delete_retention_in_days` (Number) Soft delete retention period in days.
- `subscription_name` (String) Azure subscription name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Azure resource tags.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure tenant ID from vault properties.
- `type` (String) Azure resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the vault record was last updated in CM.
- `uri` (String) URI of the vault in CipherTrust Manager.
- `vault_uri` (String) Vault URI from Azure properties.
